column1: # Bundled libraries (RAD-132, RAD-136): one line per library compiled
# into the plugins, tab-separated: name, version, licence (SPDX), pinned
# folder, upstream release archive and its SHA-256 ("-" for a git
# submodule or a vendored git commit, whose README or .gitmodules has the
# pin). deps.cmake builds talloc and libosmocore; the others are compiled
